info.title: MICROSERVICE-testDev-Create Catalog Zeolite Pendant Detail-v1-spec
info.description: This API enables the creation of detailed catalog entries for Zeolite Pendants, allowing businesses to manage their product offerings effectively. It facilitates the capture of essential information regarding each pendant, such as specifications, pricing, and availability. Typical consumers of this API include product managers and e-commerce platforms looking to enhance their catalog with accurate and comprehensive product details. This operation supports a streamlined process to populate online storefronts with the latest product information.

post.summary: Create a new zeolite pendant detail.
post.description: This endpoint allows users to create a new detail for a zeolite pendant. It expects a request body containing the required information for the pendant detail, and upon successful creation, it will respond with the details of the newly created pendant item.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to submit details for the zeolite pendant. Ensure that the JSON payload adheres to the specified schema to successfully create or update the pendant details.

200.description: The request was successful, and the zeolite pendant details are returned.

CreateCatalogZeolitePendantDetailRequest.title: Zeolite Pendant Order Request

zeolite_pendant_id.description: The unique identifier for the zeolite pendant.

requestedBy.description: The name of the person or entity requesting the order.

quantity.description: The number of zeolite pendants being requested.

isPriority.description: Indicates whether the order should be treated as a priority.

unitPrice.description: The price per individual zeolite pendant.

CreateCatalogZeolitePendantDetailRequest.description: Schema representing the request body for creating a new order of zeolite pendants.

ZeolitePendantDimensions.title: Zeolite Pendant Dimensions

width.description: The width of the zeolite pendant.

height.description: The height of the zeolite pendant.

unit.description: The unit of measurement for the dimensions (e.g., cm, inches).

ZeolitePendantDimensions.description: Schema representing the dimensions of the zeolite pendant.

recordId.description: The unique identifier of the processed record.

processedAt.description: The timestamp marking when the operation was processed.

CreateCatalogZeolitePendantDetailRespons.description: Response schema for the successful processing of a zeolite pendant operation.

currency.description: The currency in which the pricing is denominated.

taxIncluded.description: Indicates whether the tax is included in the net amount.

content-type.description: Indicates the media type of the resource returned in the response. Typical values are 'application/json' for JSON data.
